---
name: OCR error
about: latin-ocr.txt misreads the printed source — report against the page scan.
title: "[ocr] "
labels: ocr
---

**Work id**

The directory name under `works/` — the `prdl-NNNNN` prefix is enough.

**Page number**

The page in the source scan. The parallel viewer and, for the cryptographic works, the facsimile pages show the source page images; the work's `metadata.json` cites the holding institution and edition. Say which scan or image you read.

**Current OCR reading**

Quote the line or lines from `latin-ocr.txt` as they stand.

**Correct reading per the scan**

What the print actually says. Mark anything you cannot read as `[unclear]` rather than guessing; brevigraphs and ligatures may be expanded, but say so if you expand them.

**Notes (optional)**

e.g. abbreviation expansion in doubt, long-s or ligature confusion, marginalia or running-head bleed into the body text.
